name: Interest Payment Schedule 1
definition: Specifies an interest payment schedule, that is an amount that must be paid no sooner than the expected payment date and no later than the due date.

InterestScheduleIdentification.name: Interest Schedule Identification
InterestScheduleIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the interest payment schedule.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Interest amount that must be paid at due date.

DueDate.name: Due Date
DueDate.definition: Latest date whereby the interest must be paid.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the interest payments.

InterestSchedulePresenceRule.definition: At least on element must be present in the InterestPaymentSchedule.
